title: 100 verb berdampak tinggi (1–50)
blocks: Bacalah kolom-kolomnya sebagai satu word family. Kekuatan utama tabel ini bukan menghafal bentuk past tense, tetapi kemampuan berpindah dari satu bentuk ke bentuk lain dalam satu baris. Jika increase (verb) terlalu sering Anda pakai, beralihlah ke an increase (noun) atau increasing (adjective), lalu susun ulang kalimatnya. Fleksibilitas seperti inilah yang dinilai tinggi oleh Lexical Resource.
**noun**: anggota noun yang paling berguna dari family ini
**adjective**: anggota adjective yang paling berguna dari family ini
**preposition**: preposition yang paling sering muncul setelah verb atau noun-nya
**-**: tidak ada bentuk satu kata yang umum untuk kelas itu, atau tidak ada preposition yang tetap
Ejaan mengikuti aturan British (analyse, emphasise, utilise) — IELTS menerima ejaan ini dan memang mengharapkannya.

title: 100 verb berdampak tinggi (51–100)
blocks: Verb affect memiliki noun effect, bukan affect. Ini jebakan ejaan yang paling sering diuji dalam bahasa Inggris, jadi bacalah baris 5 dua kali: Anda affect sesuatu (verb), dan effect adalah hasilnya (noun).

Sebagian besar baris memungkinkan Anda melakukan paraphrase dengan mengganti kelas kata. “The policy improved education” bisa menjadi “the policy led to an improvement in education” atau “the policy had a beneficial effect on education.” Latihlah perpindahan dalam satu baris ini sampai terasa otomatis; inilah mesin paraphrase di Bab 5.

title: Panduan upgrade linking word
blocks: Cohesion dinilai secara langsung — di Writing lewat criterion Coherence and Cohesion, dan di Speaking sebagai bagian dari Fluency and Coherence. Kebanyakan kandidat menghubungkan ide dengan and, but, so, because, dan also. Kata-kata ini tidak salah, tetapi tulisan yang seluruhnya bergantung pada kata-kata ini menunjukkan level Band 6. Solusinya adalah sekumpulan device tingkat lebih tinggi yang terkontrol, dipakai dengan tepat, dan tidak ditumpuk satu di atas yang lain.
furthermore, moreover, in addition, additionally, what is more
Renewable energy is clean. Furthermore, it is becoming cheaper each year.
however, nevertheless, in contrast, conversely, on the contrary
The scheme was expensive. Nevertheless, it delivered clear benefits.
notwithstanding, despite this, even so, admittedly, granted that
Notwithstanding the cost, the investment proved worthwhile.
owing to, due to, on account of, as a result of, given that, since
Owing to a shortage of teachers, class sizes have grown.
consequently, therefore, thus, hence, as a result, accordingly
Demand fell sharply; consequently, prices dropped.
Some favour strict rules; conversely, others prefer flexibility.
for instance, to illustrate, namely, such as
Several cities, such as Dhaka and Chittagong, are expanding rapidly.
in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance, ultimately
On balance, the advantages outweigh the drawbacks.
Setelah “due to” dan “owing to” harus ada noun, bukan clause.
Due to the government invested more, education improved.
Owing to greater investment, education improved. / Education improved because the government invested more.
Device ini diikuti oleh noun atau noun phrase. Jika Anda ingin clause lengkap dengan subject dan verb, gunakan because.
The plan was costly, however, it worked.
The plan was costly. However, it worked. / The plan was costly; however, it worked.
Jika however menghubungkan dua kalimat lengkap, sebelumnya harus ada titik atau semicolon dan sesudahnya koma. Jika hanya ada koma di kedua sisinya, terjadilah comma splice, dan ini mengurangi nilai.

Satu cohesive device untuk setiap ide sudah cukup. Memulai tiga kalimat berturut-turut dengan Moreover, Furthermore, In addition adalah penggunaan berlebihan yang mekanis, dan examiner secara tegas mengurangi nilai untuk hal ini. Variasikan device-nya, dan biarkan beberapa kalimat terhubung hanya lewat maknanya. Range berarti variasi, bukan kepadatan.

blocks.title: Exercise 3.1 · Drill Bentuk Verb dan Collocation
blocks.instructions: Lengkapi setiap kalimat dengan bentuk yang benar dari verb di dalam kurung, atau dengan preposition yang tepat jika bagian kosongnya tidak disertai verb. Gunakan tabel 100 verb untuk memeriksa bentuk dan pasangan preposition.

items.prompt: Over the past decade, the urban population has ______ (grow) by nearly twenty per cent.
items.reason: present perfect memerlukan has + V3; grow adalah verb irregular (grew, grown).

items.prompt: If food prices continue ______ (rise), many families will struggle.
items.reason: continue bisa diikuti bentuk infinitive maupun bentuk -ing.

items.prompt: Rural households often depend ______ agriculture for their entire income.
items.reason: depend on adalah collocation yang tetap.

items.prompt: Many students benefit ______ free online learning resources.
items.reason: benefit from.

items.prompt: Between 2000 and 2010, car sales ______ (peak) at forty thousand units.
items.reason: simple past untuk rentang waktu yang sudah selesai.

items.prompt: Air pollution in the capital has ______ (rise) sharply since 2010.
items.reason: present perfect (has risen); rise adalah verb intransitive, jadi tidak memiliki object.

items.prompt: Governments should invest more heavily ______ public transport.
items.reason: invest in.

items.prompt: Smallpox was completely ______ (eradicate) by the end of the 1970s.
items.reason: passive voice memerlukan was + V3.

items.prompt: Automation may ______ (undermine) job security in several sectors.
items.reason: bentuk dasar muncul setelah modal may.

items.prompt: The report ______ (focus) mainly on youth unemployment.
items.reason: present simple, orang ketiga tunggal (the report focuses on).

items.prompt: By 2020, the jobless rate had ______ (fall) to a record low.
items.reason: past perfect memerlukan had + V3; fall adalah verb irregular (fell, fallen).

items.prompt: Tourism contributes significantly ______ the local economy.
items.reason: contribute to.

items.prompt: Strict penalties can ______ (deter) people ______ committing crimes.
items.reason: bentuk dasar setelah can; strukturnya adalah deter someone from doing.

items.prompt: The company has been ______ (invest) heavily in renewable technology.
items.reason: present perfect continuous memerlukan has been + V4.

items.prompt: Chronic water shortages often result ______ poor long-term planning.
items.reason: result from menunjuk ke sebab; result in menunjuk ke akibat.

items.prompt: Renewable sources are gradually ______ (replace) fossil fuels.
items.reason: present continuous memerlukan are + V4.

items.prompt: The new curriculum is ______ (design) to ______ (enhance) critical thinking.
items.reason: bentuk passive-nya is designed; bentuk dasar setelah to.

items.prompt: Coastal communities must ______ (adapt) ______ rising sea levels.
items.reason: bentuk dasar setelah must; adapt to.

items.prompt: Over the last century, average temperatures have ______ (rise) steadily.
items.reason: present perfect (have risen).

items.prompt: The charity has ______ (provide) thousands of families ______ clean water.
items.reason: present perfect has provided; provide someone with something.

blocks.title: Exercise 3.2 · Transformasi dengan Cohesive Device
blocks.instructions: Paragraph di bawah ini kira-kira berada di level Band 6.0. Idenya sudah benar, tetapi kalimat-kalimatnya pendek dan hanya dihubungkan dengan connector dasar. Tulis ulang menjadi satu paragraph yang terhubung baik di level Band 8.0 sampai 9.0, dengan memakai cohesive device tingkat lebih tinggi secara tepat dan bervariasi. Jangan menambahkan ide baru; perbaiki hanya penghubung dan alurnya.

items.prompt: Online education has become very popular. It is cheaper than traditional classes. Students can also study from home. But it has some problems. There is less interaction with teachers. Also, many students lack self-discipline. So, a lot of them do not finish their courses. Online education is useful. But it cannot fully replace the classroom.
items.answer: Online education has grown enormously in popularity, largely because it is cheaper than traditional classes and allows students to study from home. Notwithstanding these advantages, it carries certain drawbacks. To begin with, there is far less interaction with teachers. Moreover, many learners lack the self-discipline that independent study demands; consequently, a significant proportion fail to complete their courses. Online education is therefore undeniably useful, yet it cannot fully replace the classroom.
items.reason: because dengan tepat memperkenalkan clause lengkap, sedangkan Notwithstanding dengan tepat diikuti noun phrase (these advantages), bukan clause; semicolon sebelum consequently menggabungkan dua clause yang saling berkaitan; tidak ada device yang diulang, sehingga cohesion-nya bervariasi, bukan mekanis.
